topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The opening outlines the lecture's objectives and scope regarding cancer therapies.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine conventional local and systemic cancer therapies alongside mechanisms of non-specific toxicity and multidrug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting cellular vulnerabilities and hormone dependence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address therapeutic approaches that selectively exploit tumor cell vulnerabilities, DNA repair deficiencies, and hormonal dependencies.

topics.label: Kinase inhibitors and targeted drug resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the design of targeted small-molecule kinase inhibitors and the molecular mechanisms driving drug resistance.

topics.label: Antibody-based therapies and drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the mechanism of action and clinical application of targeted monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and immune-mediated targeting
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine natural immune surveillance against tumors and therapeutic strategies that harness the immune system to eliminate cancer cells.

topics.label: Challenges, historical progress, and future directions in cancer treatment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize the broader clinical challenges, historical outcomes, and future directions in cancer therapy and management.
